cookbook.recipe_name: Scrambled Eggs, Buttered Toast & Apple Slices
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B1 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2.5 eggs (4.4 oz); starch 2 slices toast; veg 1/2 apple (fruit). Prep 10 min, cook 15 min. Equipment: Large non-stick pan or griddle, big bowl, whisk, sheet pans, oven. Est. cost $23.91 ($1.49 per person). Galley notes: Cook eggs in two batches so they stay soft. In rough seas use a deep pot instead of a flat pan.

instructions.instructions: Crack 40 eggs into a large bowl. Add 1 cup long-life milk, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper. Whisk until smooth.
Heat oven to 400°F. Lay bread on sheet pans and spread lightly with margarine.
Toast bread 4–6 min until golden. Keep warm.
Melt 2 tbsp margarine in the pan over medium-low. Cook eggs in two batches, pushing slowly from the edges to the centre. Pull off the heat while still slightly wet.
Core apples and cut into slices; serve right away.
Plate: ~2/3 cup eggs, 2 slices toast, 1/2 apple. Ketchup and pepper sauce on the table.

cookbook.recipe_name: Buttermilk Pancakes, Fried Eggs & Chicken Sausage
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B2 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 eggs + 1.5 oz sausage (5 oz); starch 3 pancakes; veg -. Prep 10 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Griddle or 2 large pans, mixing bowl, ladle, sheet pan, oven. Est. cost $24.45 ($1.53 per person). Galley notes: Use a high-sided bowl for batter — it sloshes under way. Leftover pancakes freeze well for snacks.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 1.5 lb · Prep: Whole links (bag label B2)

instructions.instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Lay sausages on a sheet pan.
Bake sausages 15–18 min, turning once, until 165°F inside. Hold at 200°F.
Whisk 1.5 kg pancake mix with water per the bag (~7 cups) until just combined. Rest 5 min.
Grease the griddle lightly. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; flip when bubbles pop (~2 min), cook 1 min more. Hold in the warm oven.
Fry eggs 6–8 at a time in a little oil, 2–3 min.
Plate: 3 pancakes with margarine and syrup, 2 eggs, ~1.5 oz sausage.

cookbook.recipe_name: Breakfast Burritos (egg, chicken sausage, peppers, cheddar)
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B3 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 eggs + 1 oz sausage + 0.5 oz cheese (5 oz); starch 1 large tortilla; veg 1 oz peppers + 1 oz onion. Prep 15 min, cook 20 min. Equipment: Large pan or wok, whisk, bowl, foil. Est. cost $27.48 ($1.72 per person). Galley notes: Foil-wrapped burritos are easy to eat on watch. Reheat in a 325°F oven for 15 min.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 1 lb · Prep: Whole links (bag label B3)

instructions.instructions: Dice 1 lb peppers and 1 lb onions. Slice sausages into coins.
Heat oil over medium-high. Brown sausage 4–5 min, add peppers and onions; cook 4 min until soft.
Whisk 32 eggs with 1.5 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper.
Lower heat, pour eggs over the sausage mix and stir gently until just set.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in a 300°F oven.
Fill each tortilla with ~3/4 cup filling and a sprinkle of shredded cheddar; fold, roll tight and wrap in foil.

cookbook.recipe_name: Oatmeal, Hard-Boiled Eggs & PB Toast
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B4 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 eggs + 1 oz peanut butter (4.5 oz); starch 1 cup oatmeal + 1 slice toast; veg -. Prep 10 min, cook 20 min. Equipment: Large pot (oats), medium pot (eggs), bowl of cold water, oven or toaster. Est. cost $19.42 ($1.21 per person). Galley notes: Eggs a few days old peel more easily. Leftover hard-boiled eggs keep 5 days chilled.

instructions.instructions: Put 32 eggs in a pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, bring to a boil.
Cover, turn off the heat and leave 10 min. Move to cold water for 5 min.
Bring 14 cups water and 1 tsp salt to a boil in the large pot.
Stir in 1.2 kg oats; simmer 5–8 min, stirring, until thick. Stir in 4 cups milk.
Toast 16 slices bread; spread each with ~2 tbsp peanut butter (1 oz).
Stir the sugar and cinnamon into the oatmeal; thin with a splash of milk if needed.
Serve 1 cup oatmeal, 2 eggs and 1 slice PB toast per person.

cookbook.recipe_name: Egg, Bacon & Cheese Toast Sandwiches
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B5 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 eggs + 1 oz bacon (4.5 oz); starch 2 slices toast; veg -. Prep 10 min, cook 25 min. Equipment: Sheet pans, oven, griddle or large pan. Est. cost $23.93 ($1.50 per person). Galley notes: Save bacon fat to fry eggs or potatoes later. Baking bacon means no splatter under way.

instructions.instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Lay bacon in one layer on a sheet pan.
Bake 12–15 min until crisp. Drain and cut strips in half.
Spread bread with margarine and toast on sheet pans 4–6 min.
Fry eggs 8 at a time; break the yolks and cook through. Season.
Build: toast, 2 eggs, 1 cheese slice, bacon, toast.
Cut in half; serve with ketchup or pepper sauce.

cookbook.recipe_name: Potato, Pepper & Egg Hash with Hot Dog Bits
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B6 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 eggs + 1 oz hot dog (4.5 oz); starch ~5 oz fresh potato hash; veg 1.5 oz peppers + 1 oz onion. Prep 15 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Large pot, 2 large pans or sheet pans, knife and board. Est. cost $20.15 ($1.26 per person). Galley notes: Par-boil potatoes the night before to save propane in the morning.

instructions.instructions: Scrub 5 lb potatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Dice peppers and onions. Slice hot dogs into coins.
Boil potatoes in salted water 6–8 min until just tender. Drain and steam-dry 2 min.
Fry potatoes in oil over medium-high until browned (or roast at 425°F for 20 min).
Add onions, peppers and hot dogs; cook 5 min. Season with paprika, salt and pepper; top with cheddar.
Fry or scramble 32 eggs and serve 2 per person over the hash.
Serve with ketchup or pepper sauce.

cookbook.recipe_name: French Toast, Scrambled Eggs & PB/Jelly
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu B7 · serves 16. Per person: protein 1 egg in batter + 1.5 scrambled (4.4 oz); starch 2 slices French toast; veg -. Prep 10 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Griddle or large pans, shallow dish, whisk, sheet pan, oven. Est. cost $23.75 ($1.48 per person). Galley notes: Slightly stale bread works best.

instructions.instructions: Heat oven to 200°F for holding. Whisk 16 eggs, 4 cups milk, sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Grease the griddle with margarine. Dip bread 2–3 sec per side; cook 2–3 min per side until golden. Hold in the oven.
Whisk 24 eggs with salt and pepper; scramble over medium-low in margarine.
Set out peanut butter, jelly and syrup.
Plate: 2 slices French toast and ~1/3 cup scrambled egg.

cookbook.recipe_name: Shredded Chicken Burrito Bowls with Peppers, Onions & Corn Salsa
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L1 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Peppers 1.5 oz + onion 1 oz + corn 2.1 oz + tomato 0.9 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, rice pot, large pan, forks for shredding. Est. cost $32.53 ($2.03 per person). Galley notes: Leg quarters: 12 oz raw bone-in yields ~8 oz meat.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, leave thigh/leg meat in whole pieces (bag label L1)

instructions.instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Rub 10 lb leg quarters with oil, 2 tbsp complete seasoning and salt.
Roast 45 min to 175°F. Cool 10 min, pull the meat off the bones and shred.
Cook 2 lb rice with 1:1.5 water and 1 tsp salt, covered, 18 min.
Slice 1.5 lb peppers and 1 lb onions; sauté in oil with garlic and 1 tbsp complete seasoning until soft.
Salsa: mix half a can of drained corn with 1 can diced tomatoes and a dash of pepper sauce.
Bowl: 6 oz rice, chicken, peppers & onions, corn salsa, sprinkle of cheddar.

cookbook.recipe_name: Chicken & Bean Chili over Rice
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L2 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Tomato 3.6 oz + peppers 0.5 oz + onion 1 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, heavy pot, rice pot. Est. cost $32.86 ($2.05 per person). Galley notes: Chili reheats well under way.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, 1" dice (bag label L2)

instructions.instructions: Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F for 45 min. Pull meat off the bones.
In a heavy pot heat oil; add 1 lb diced onions, 0.5 lb diced peppers and garlic; cook 5 min.
Add 2 tbsp complete seasoning and 1/2 tsp cayenne; stir 1 min.
Add 4 cans diced tomatoes, 2 cans drained kidney beans, chicken and 1 cup water. Simmer 20–25 min.
Cook 2 lb rice.
Serve 6 oz rice topped with chili and cheddar.

cookbook.recipe_name: Cheeseburgers, Fries & Coleslaw
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L3 · serves 16. Per person: protein 2 x 4 oz beef patties (8 oz); starch Bun 2.2 oz + fries 4 oz; veg Coleslaw: cabbage 2 oz + carrots 2 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Sheet pans or griddle, oven, big bowl, grater. Est. cost $59.32 ($3.71 per person). Galley notes: Make the slaw first so it has time to chill.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 32 patties (8 lb) · Prep: No cutting. Repack 16 per bag with paper between (bag label L3)

instructions.instructions: Coleslaw: finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrots. Toss with mayo, 1 tbsp sugar, salt and pepper. Chill until serving.
Lay out 32 frozen 4 oz patties; season both sides with granulated garlic and onion, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. No need to thaw.
Bake 4 lb fries at 425°F 20–25 min, turning once.
Cook patties from frozen 4–5 min per side to 160°F; top with cheese in the last minute. 2 patties per burger.
Toast buns cut-side down.
Burger, 4 oz fries and ~4 oz coleslaw, with ketchup and mustard.

cookbook.recipe_name: Chicken Quesadillas & Spanish Rice
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L4 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Tortilla 2.5 oz + rice 3.6 oz; veg Peppers 1.5 oz + onion 1 oz + tomato 1.8 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, griddle, rice pot, oven. Est. cost $37.53 ($2.35 per person). Galley notes: Hold finished quesadillas in a 250°F oven.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, leave thigh/leg meat in whole pieces (bag label L4)

instructions.instructions: Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F with oil, paprika and salt. Pull the meat.
Spanish rice: fry 1.2 lb rice in oil 3 min, add 1 can diced tomatoes, 3 bouillon cubes and water to 1:1.75. Cover and simmer 20 min.
Sauté 1.5 lb sliced peppers and 1 lb onions until soft; mix with chicken, 1 can drained diced tomatoes and 2 tbsp complete seasoning.
Fill tortillas with filling and cheddar; fold and toast on the griddle 2 min per side.
Quesadilla wedges with 3.5 oz Spanish rice; pepper sauce on the side.

cookbook.recipe_name: Bean Chili Dogs, Fries & Buttered Corn
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L5 · serves 16. Per person: protein Jumbo hot dogs 8 oz (with bean chili); starch 2 buns 3 oz + fries 3 oz; veg Corn 4.2 oz + tomato 0.9 oz + onion 1 oz. Prep 10 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Sheet pans, oven, pot, pan. Est. cost $45.28 ($2.83 per person). Galley notes: Warm buns wrapped in foil in the oven.

instructions.instructions: Bake 3 lb fries at 425°F 20–25 min.
Chili: soften 1 lb diced onions in a little oil, add 1 can drained kidney beans (lightly mashed), 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 tbsp complete seasoning and 1/4 tsp cayenne; simmer 10 min.
Simmer or griddle 8 lb hot dogs until hot through.
Heat 1 can drained corn with margarine.
2 hot dogs in buns with chili, mustard and ketchup; fries and corn.

cookbook.recipe_name: Chicken Fried Rice
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L6 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Mixed veg 3 oz + onion 1 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, rice pot, wok or largest pan. Est. cost $33.28 ($2.08 per person). Galley notes: Fry in 2–3 batches so the rice fries instead of steaming.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, 1/2" dice (bag label L6)

instructions.instructions: Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F for 45 min. Pull and chop the meat.
Cook 2 lb rice; spread on a tray to cool (day-old rice is best).
Scramble 8 eggs; set aside.
Heat oil very hot. Fry 1 lb diced onions and garlic 2 min, add 3 lb frozen mixed vegetables; cook 4 min.
Add rice and chicken in batches; stir-fry 5 min. Add ~1 cup soy sauce and the eggs.
Serve with pepper sauce.

cookbook.recipe_name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches, Potato Wedges & Slaw
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L7 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Bun 2.2 oz + potato wedges 4 oz; veg Slaw: cabbage 2 oz + carrots 2 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, sheet pans, pot, big bowl, grater. Est. cost $36.95 ($2.31 per person). Galley notes: Pulled chicken keeps 3 days chilled.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, leave thigh/leg meat in whole pieces (bag label L7)

instructions.instructions: Coleslaw: finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrots. Toss with mayo, 1 tbsp sugar, salt and pepper. Chill until serving.
Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F with paprika, granulated garlic and salt, 45–50 min.
Pull the meat and toss with 1 kg BBQ sauce; warm through.
Wedges: cut 4.5 lb potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt; roast at 425°F 30–35 min, turning once.
Bun with BBQ chicken, 4 oz wedges and ~4 oz slaw (on the side or in the bun).

cookbook.recipe_name: Shredded Beef Soft Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L8 · serves 16. Per person: protein Braised beef stew meat 8 oz; starch Tortilla 1.5 oz + rice 4.5 oz; veg Cabbage 2.5 oz + onion 1 oz + tomato 0.9 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Large heavy pot or pressure cooker, rice pot, big bowl. Est. cost $61.51 ($3.84 per person). Galley notes: Cabbage keeps 2–3 weeks chilled — buy it with the fresh restock.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 3.63 kg (8 lb) · Prep: leave large 1.5–2" chunks (shred after cooking) (bag label L8)

instructions.instructions: Cook 1.5 lb rice.

Thaw 8 lb stew meat overnight in the fridge. Brown in batches with 1 lb diced onions; add garlic, 3 tbsp all-purpose seasoning, 1/4 tsp cayenne and 3 cups water. Cover and simmer 2 hr (40 min in a pressure cooker) until fork-tender, then shred with two forks and cook down until the sauce clings.
Cabbage slaw: shred 2.5 lb cabbage; toss with ~3/4 cup mayo, a dash of pepper sauce and salt.
Drain 1 can diced tomatoes for topping.
Warm tortillas.
2 tacos per person with beef, slaw and tomato; 4.5 oz rice on the side.

cookbook.recipe_name: Sausage, Peppers & Onions with Boxed Mac and Cheese
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L9 · serves 16. Per person: protein Chicken sausage 8 oz; starch Mac & cheese ~6.5 oz prepared; veg Peppers 3 oz + onion 2 oz + tomato 0.9 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Sheet pans, oven, large pot, large pan. Est. cost $59.87 ($3.74 per person). Galley notes: Boxed mac & cheese replaces the old roasted-potato side.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 8 lb · Prep: Whole links (bag label L9)

instructions.instructions: Bake 8 lb chicken sausages at 400°F 20–25 min, turning once, to 165°F.
Slice 3 lb peppers and 2 lb onions into strips. Sauté in oil with garlic and oregano 8 min; add 1 can diced tomatoes and simmer 5 min.
Boxed mac & cheese: boil 6 boxes of macaroni in salted water 7–8 min; drain.
Stir in the cheese packets, 1/2 cup margarine and ~1.5 cups milk.
Slice sausages and toss with the peppers and onions.
8 oz sausage, peppers & onions with ~6.5 oz mac & cheese.

cookbook.recipe_name: Chicken Ranch Pasta Salad
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu L10 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Penne 6 oz cooked; veg Peppers 1.5 oz + carrot 0.5 oz + onion 0.5 oz + corn 2.1 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, large pot, big mixing bowl. Est. cost $31.50 ($1.97 per person). Galley notes: No bottled ranch at PriceSmart TT, so the dressing is made from mayo and pantry spices.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, 3/4" dice (bag label L10)

instructions.instructions: Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F for 45 min. Cool, pull and chop.
Boil 2.67 lb penne; drain, rinse cold, toss with a little oil.
Ranch-style dressing: whisk ~2 cups mayo, 3/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp granulated garlic, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp sugar and salt.
Dice 1.5 lb peppers and 0.5 lb onion; grate 0.5 lb carrots; drain half a can of corn.
Toss pasta, chicken, vegetables and dressing. Chill.
~1.5 cups per person.

cookbook.recipe_name: Spaghetti & Beef Ragu, Garlic Buttered Carrots
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D1 · serves 16. Per person: protein Braised beef stew meat 8 oz; starch Spaghetti 6 oz cooked; veg Carrots 4 oz + tomato 1.8 oz + onion 0.5 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Large pot (pasta), heavy pot or pressure cooker (ragu), pan. Est. cost $64.09 ($4.01 per person). Galley notes: Sauce can be made the day before.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 3.63 kg (8 lb) · Prep: Trim fat and silver skin, 1" dice (bag label D1)

instructions.instructions: Thaw 8 lb stew meat overnight in the fridge; cut into 1-inch pieces. Brown in batches with 0.5 lb diced onion.

Add garlic, oregano, 1 jar pasta sauce, 2 cans diced tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and 2 cups water. Cover and simmer 1 hr 45 min (35 min in a pressure cooker) until the beef falls apart; break it up into the sauce with a fork.
Boil 2.67 lb spaghetti 9–10 min; drain.
Garlic carrots: slice 4 lb carrots into coins; boil 8–10 min until tender, drain, toss with margarine and a little garlic.
6 oz spaghetti with beef ragu and ~4 oz carrots.

cookbook.recipe_name: BBQ Baked Chicken Leg Quarters, Boxed Mashed Potatoes, Corn & Carrots
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D2 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Mashed potatoes ~6 oz; veg Corn 4.2 oz + carrots 3 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, oven, 2 pots. Est. cost $48.45 ($3.03 per person). Galley notes: Boxed mashed potatoes — no peeling, and the pouches keep for months.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Leave whole, skin on (bag label D2)

instructions.instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Season 10 lb leg quarters with paprika, granulated garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast 40 min.
Brush with 1 kg BBQ sauce; roast 15 min more to 175°F.
Boxed mashed potatoes: bring water (per pouch, ~2 cups each), 1/4 cup margarine and the milk to a boil; stir in 6 pouches, rest 2 min.
Slice 3 lb carrots; boil 8–10 min. Heat 1 can drained corn. Toss both with margarine.
1 leg quarter, ~6 oz mashed potatoes, corn & carrots.

cookbook.recipe_name: Caribbean Stew Chicken, Rice & Peas, Stewed Carrots
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D3 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice & peas 6 oz cooked; veg Carrots 3 oz + onion 1 oz + tomato 1.8 oz + peas & carrots 1.2 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Heavy pot or Dutch oven, rice pot. Est. cost $34.01 ($2.13 per person). Galley notes: Browning gives colour fast if a sugar caramel feels risky in a seaway.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Split at the joint into thigh + drumstick, skin off (bag label D3)

instructions.instructions: Cut leg quarters into pieces. Season with green seasoning, garlic, salt and pepper (overnight if possible).
Heat oil and 2 tbsp sugar until dark caramel, add browning, then brown the chicken in batches.
Add 1 lb sliced onions, 2 cans diced tomatoes, 4 bouillon cubes and 2 cups water. Cover and simmer 35 min.
Rice & peas: cook 2 lb rice with 2 cans drained pigeon peas, a little green seasoning, salt and water 1:1.75.
Stewed carrots: add 3 lb sliced carrots for the last 15 min, and 2 cans drained peas & carrots for the last 5 min.
Stew chicken over rice & peas with gravy and vegetables.

cookbook.recipe_name: Beef Tips in Onion Gravy, White Rice, Peas & Carrots
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D4 · serves 16. Per person: protein Beef tips 8 oz (stew meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Green peas 3 oz + carrots 3 oz + onion 1 oz. Prep 25 min, cook 50 min. Equipment: Heavy pot or pressure cooker, pot, rice pot. Est. cost $62.31 ($3.89 per person). Galley notes: Move the stew meat to the fridge the night before so it is thawed by dinner.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 3.63 kg (8 lb) · Prep: 1.5" chunks (fine to leave as is if about this size) (bag label D4)

instructions.instructions: Thaw 8 lb stew meat overnight in the fridge. Season with garlic, salt and pepper; brown in batches in the heavy pot and set aside.

Onion gravy in the same pot: cook 1 lb sliced onions in margarine until golden; stir in 1 cup flour, then 6 bouillon cubes dissolved in 8 cups hot water and a splash of browning. Return the beef, cover and simmer 1 hr 30 min (30 min in a pressure cooker) until tender.
Skim off fat; season the gravy with salt and pepper and thin with hot water if too thick.
Cook 2 lb rice.
Boil 3 lb sliced carrots 8 min, add 3 lb frozen peas for 2 min; drain and toss with margarine.
8 oz beef tips with gravy, 6 oz rice, peas & carrots.

cookbook.recipe_name: Chicken Alfredo Penne with Broccoli
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D5 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat), pulled; starch Penne 6 oz cooked; veg Broccoli 6 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, large pot, large pan. Est. cost $60.68 ($3.79 per person). Galley notes: Using pulled leg-quarter meat instead of breast keeps the budget under $6,000.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Debone + skin off, 1" dice (bag label D5)

instructions.instructions: Roast 10 lb leg quarters at 400°F with granulated garlic, salt and pepper. Pull the meat into bite-size pieces.
Boil 2.67 lb penne in salted water; drain.
Sauce: melt margarine, add garlic, whisk in 1/4 cup flour, then 4 cups milk; simmer until thick. Stir in 3 jars Alfredo sauce.
Steam or boil 6 lb frozen broccoli 4–5 min; drain.
Toss penne, chicken and sauce.
Serve 6 oz penne with chicken and ~6 oz broccoli on the side or tossed in.

cookbook.recipe_name: Braised Beef Shepherd's Pie (boxed mashed potato topping)
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D6 · serves 16. Per person: protein Braised beef stew meat 8 oz; starch Mashed potato topping ~6 oz; veg Peas & carrots 3.6 oz + carrots 1 oz + onion 1 oz + corn 1.3 oz. Prep 25 min, cook 30 min. Equipment: Heavy pot or pressure cooker, deep hotel pans, oven, pot. Est. cost $76.26 ($4.77 per person). Galley notes: Boxed mashed potatoes make the topping in 5 minutes.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 3.63 kg (8 lb) · Prep: 1/2" dice (may need to cut large chunks smaller) (bag label D6)

instructions.instructions: Thaw 8 lb stew meat overnight in the fridge; cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Brown in batches with 1 lb diced onions and 1 lb diced carrots.
Stir in 1/2 cup flour, 4 bouillon cubes dissolved in 5 cups water and a splash of browning. Cover and simmer 1 hr 30 min (30 min in a pressure cooker) until the beef is tender and the gravy is thick.
Fold in 6 cans drained peas & carrots and a third of a can of drained corn. Spread in pans.
Prepare 6 pouches boxed mashed potatoes with margarine and milk; spread over the filling; top with cheddar.
Bake at 400°F 20–25 min.
Cut into 16 portions.

cookbook.recipe_name: Curry Chicken (bone-in) over Rice with Vegetables
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D7 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Mixed veg 3.5 oz + carrots 1 oz + onion 1 oz + tomato 0.9 oz. Prep 20 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Heavy pot, rice pot. Est. cost $35.45 ($2.22 per person). Galley notes: Frying the curry powder first is the key to good flavour.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Split at the joint into thigh + drumstick, skin off (bag label D7)

instructions.instructions: Cut leg quarters into pieces. Season with green seasoning, garlic and salt.
Heat oil; fry 1 lb sliced onions 3 min, then 1/2 cup curry powder mixed with a little water 1–2 min.
Add chicken and turn to coat; cook 5–8 min.
Add 1 lb sliced carrots, 1 can diced tomatoes, 4 bouillon cubes and 3 cups water; cover and simmer 35 min.
Add 3.5 lb frozen mixed vegetables; simmer 5–8 min.
Cook 2 lb rice.
Curry over 6 oz rice.

cookbook.recipe_name: Baked Chicken & Rice (Arroz con Pollo) with Coleslaw
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D8 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Rice 6 oz cooked; veg Peppers 1.25 oz + onion 1 oz + tomato 0.9 oz + slaw (cabbage 2.5 oz + carrots 2.5 oz). Prep 20 min, cook 70 min. Equipment: Hotel pans, oven, foil, big bowl, grater. Est. cost $34.07 ($2.13 per person). Galley notes: One-pan main — less washing up.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Split at the joint into thigh + drumstick, skin on (bag label D8)

instructions.instructions: Season leg quarters with paprika, complete seasoning, garlic and salt; brown or roast at 425°F 20 min.
Dice 1.25 lb peppers and 1 lb onions.
In the pans mix 2 lb rice, peppers, onions, 1 can diced tomatoes and 4 bouillon cubes dissolved in 6 cups hot water.
Nestle chicken on top, cover with foil and bake at 375°F 40–45 min.
Coleslaw: shred 2.5 lb cabbage and grate 2.5 lb carrots; toss with mayo, 1 tbsp sugar, salt and pepper. Chill.
1 leg quarter with 6 oz rice and coleslaw.

cookbook.recipe_name: Garlic Roast Chicken Legs, Roast Potatoes, Peas & Carrots
cookbook.summary: WIT 7-week menu D9 · serves 16. Per person: protein Leg quarter 10 oz bone-in (~6.5 oz meat); starch Roast potatoes 6 oz; veg Green peas 3 oz + carrots 3 oz. Prep 15 min, cook 60 min. Equipment: Roasting pans, sheet pans, oven, pot. Est. cost $34.09 ($2.13 per person). Galley notes: Roast the potatoes on the top rack alongside the chicken.

ingredients.prep_notes: 16 crew: 10 lb · Prep: Leave whole, skin on (bag label D9)

instructions.instructions: Mix minced garlic, oil, granulated garlic, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper; rub over 10 lb leg quarters.
Roast at 400°F 45–50 min to 175°F.
Roast potatoes: cut 7 lb potatoes into chunks, toss with oil, salt and garlic; roast at 425°F 35–40 min, turning once.
